QuestInfo.name: Catching the Water Thief Monster
QuestInfo.0: Go see #b#p2152010##k, who is in charge of Resistance supplies, and help him with his problem.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2152010# engages in bartering in order to find financial support for the Resistance. Of the items he trades, water is one of the most important commodities. However, it appears that a #o2150000# has come and stolen all the water. Head over to #b#m310030200##k and teach the #r#o2150000##k a lesson, then bring the #b#t4000601##k over to the #bstorage next to Surl#k to fill up the tank. You must fill the water tank all the way.

#bFill the water tank with water#k

Caution#n
1. You need at least #b10 #t4000601##k items.
2. #bYou must drop one bottle of water at a time#k.

demand.base: Fill the water tank with water
